description: This source file implements the core logic for managing a stack of reference tables in a version control system, including functions for creating, destroying, reloading, and optimizing the stack through compaction and maintenance. It handles file IO, locking, and synchronization mechanisms, and interacts with various external modules representing tables, errors, and writers.

methods.name: int stack_filename(struct reftable_buf * dest,struct reftable_stack * st,const char * name)
methods.description: Constructs a filename path based on the reftable directory and a given reference name.

methods.description: Performs a file sync operation based on provided options.

methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor, handling partial writes and retries.

methods.description: Callback for writing data via file descriptor.

methods.name: int fd_writer_flush(void * arg)
methods.description: Flushes the file descriptor, performing a sync.

methods.description: Reads lines (file names) from a file descriptor into an array.

methods.description: Opens a file and reads lines into an array.

methods.description: Reloads the stack if it is outdated.
